tools.name: GetBash PRD Generarot
tools.description: Generates a complete Product Requirements Document in seconds from diverse inputs—competitor pages, meeting notes, audio—so you can focus on refining the PRD rather than drafting it.
bullets: Instant PRD creation from URLs, audio, or text
Built-in chat editor for instant tweaks and brainstorming

tools.name: ChatPRD
tools.description: AI‑copilot that drafts polished PRDs from simple prompts, offering real‑time CPO‑style feedback to ensure clarity and completeness.
bullets: 30‑minute PRD drafting with professional output
Rich template library and custom template uploads

tools.name: Brilworks PRD Generator
tools.description: Creates structured PRDs by automatically extracting features, user stories, and market insights from brief inputs.
bullets: Auto‑extracts features and stories
Suggests competitive‑based feature ideas

tools.name: Aigents
tools.description: Automates PRD generation as one of its AI agents, letting you focus on strategy while it produces the document.
bullets: PM‑focused agent for PRD creation
Web‑based, no setup required

tools.name: Signlz

bullets: Unified PRD & task workflow in one tool
AI‑driven editing and refinement

tools.name: Wisary
tools.description: Embedded in Confluence, it guides PRD creation, fills gaps, and turns specs into actionable stories without leaving your documents.
bullets: Contextual AI prompts to avoid missing details
Transforms PRDs into engineering‑ready user stories
